limitations: Offline model-choice fixtures only; all future states are synthetic and do not claim current runtime support.
Choices represent permitted dialogue or planning decisions. They do not prove exact native effects, movement, persistence, or transaction success.
Allowed choice sets preserve legitimate variation, including refusal, uncertainty, clarification, and alternatives. They do not encode hidden willingness beyond supplied facts.

Multi-turn cases contain player turns and factual state updates only. The evaluator must append the model's actual selected choice and resulting observed facts; never teacher-force a gold future model reply.

scoring.method: case-level choice-set scoring; score one point when selected choice is allowed, zero otherwise; report weighted quality by severity and coverage by capabilityId
scoring.reporting: Report weighted quality percent, raw choice accuracy, per-capability coverage, severity-weighted mistake counts, and each critical/major mistake. Higher percentage is better; this suite has no global model-quality pass threshold.
scoring.separateContractTests: Deterministic save ancestry, branch filtering, snapshot binding, native capability, transaction, and effect-integrity contracts require independent tests. Model choice accuracy cannot pass or waive those tests.
